raw: Our revenue is dependent on export markets. For the period under review, our export revenue accounted for 8.40% of our total revenue from operations. Any adverse developments in these international markets, changes in trade policies, fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, or disruptions in international shipping could significantly impact our business operations, financial condition, and overall results of operations. We cannot assure you that we will be able to maintain or expand our export markets, and any failure to do so could adversely affect our business prospects and profitability.
